text:
ana: Quick heads-up 1 - Coastal Credit is ready to sign but compliance proofpack is the last blocker. They want: SOC2 control mapping (not full report), ISO scope summary, signed pen-test authorization, short KMS custody note, and a small network diagram for Dedicated. Need all artifacts before their legal review next Tue.

kevin: Copy. Which artifacts are acceptable as examples vs originals? They asked if we can send redacted logs.

meera: We usually provide: control-to-evidence table, policy excerpts (access control, incident response), and sample sanitized logs. Raw logs require DPA changes. I'll prepare mapping + indicate redaction status per item. ETA: tomorrow noon.

oliver: Pen-test letter 1: I can draft a minimal authorization. Legal sign usually 48 hours. Also need vendor name + target IPs/CIDR. If they want external scan on Dedicated, ops must assign a static CIDR.

ana: ops-bot: ticket OPS-9123 opened for CIDR assignment and diagram request.

ops-bot: NOTICE: OPS-9123 created. Owner: infra-team. Estimated diagram delivery: 36-48 hrs after CIDR confirmed.

kevin: Pricing question: they want a 90-day Dedicated POC rate. Short answer: Dedicated requires a commit; we can do a short-term commit with reduced uplift. I'll run numbers and post a quote draft.

meera: For KMS custody blurb: two options. 1) Redwood-managed keys (we hold keys; no export) or 2) Customer-managed BYOK in their HSM (recommended for sensitive workloads). I'll draft a one-paragraph custody statement for the POC with BYOK option noted.

oliver: Draft pen-letter snippet: ```
Redwood Inference authorizes [vendor] to perform coordinated, non-destructive penetration testing against specified targets: [IPs/CIDRs]. Testing must be scheduled in advance and coordinated with Redwood SRE. Any critical vulnerabilities must be reported immediately. Tests must not access or exfiltrate customer data.
```

ana: Customer replied: "Prefer no raw logs; control mapping + policy excerpts + signed pen-letter + KMS note is fine. Also confirm whether Dedicated POC pricing can be refunded if canceled early."

kevin: We can offer a refundable 60-day commit with a prorated refund up to a cutoff (commercial exception). I'll confirm with pricing ops and post final numbers by EOD.

meera: Will mark sample logs as "sanitized" and include instructions for DPA amendment if they need raw data.

oliver: Pushing pen-letter to Legal now. If they want signature today, we'll need vendor name + proposed window.

ana: I'll ask the customer for vendor name and whether they want authenticated or external scans.

kevin: Action items: meera - SOC2 mapping + iso summary (tomorrow noon), oliver - pen-letter draft & legal (48 hrs), infra - CIDR/diagram (36-48 hrs after Dedicated confirm), kevin - pricing quote (EOD). I'll set a Wed call to finalize.

ana: Thanks team 1 :thumbsup:

ops-bot: OPS-9123 updated: awaiting CIDR confirmation from customer.
